pages.text: $(italic)A celestial being cast from grace. Frail but devastatingly lethal.$()$(br2)$(bold)Lethal Grace$(): $(item)+15% on all damage you deal$(), the highest racial damage bonus.$(br2)$(bold)Bloodthirst$(): permanent Strength I.$(br2)$(bold)Tattered Wings$(): slow fall, though not true flight.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Dark Expulsion$(): dash forward and leave a withering cloud behind (25s cooldown).$(br2)$(bold)Wither Shot$(): fire a wither skull (3s cooldown).$(br2)$(bold)Dark Resilience$(): immune to Wither, Poison, Instant Damage and Nausea.$(br2)$(bold)Claustrophobia$(): $(warn)you slow down with a block right above your head.$()

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Fragile$(): $(warn)-20% max HP$() (2 fewer hearts).$(br2)$(bold)Meat Preference$(): you crave meat to fuel your war.$(br2)$(bold)Fire Vulnerability$(): $(warn)fire sears you deeper than most.$()$(br2)$(bold)Next: eat widely anyway. Spice of Life max-HP bonuses claw back your missing hearts.$()
